name: Kohechi (Mountain Route)
summary: The mountain route between the two sacred centres of the Kii Peninsula: 63 km from Koyasan to Kumano Hongu Taisha, crossing three passes above 1,000 m. Four days, with the nights at the river-valley settlements of Omata, Miura-guchi and Totsukawa Onsen. The high point is Obako-dake at 1,344 m, and the route carries about 3,500 m of ascent against 4,280 m of descent.

stages.name: Totsukawa Onsen to Kumano Hongu Taisha
